The '''''Destrier''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[77th Air Wing]] was assigned to the ''Destrier'' and the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fought in various engagements against [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] along the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Star Destroyer was attached to the [[Western Reaches Superiority Force]], a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] [[Bannidge Holt]] and [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] that had been tasked with [[Western Reaches Operation|driving]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] holdouts from the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] region.
